name: shahdara-team
summary: ONE orchestrator for OfferPk/shahdara-isp-billing. SOLO MODE since 2026-10-18 (John): only agent4 polish-qa runs, every turn, doing a top-to-bottom full functional pass (every button/function working + polished, real-browser Playwright checks, real-click e2e tests); fixes open 'grok-review' GitHub issues first (Fixes #N). agent1/2/3 paused; team-mode files kept in team-mode/. Gate script: ticks never interrupt a run.
source: Copy of sidecars\shahdara-team\sidecar.json + shahdara-project\TEAM.md, TEAM_PROMPT.txt, team-gate.ps1, AGENTS.md, agentN\TASK.md from John's PC (updated 2026-10-18: solo agent4 mode + grok-review issues). Team-mode (6-slot rotation) versions in team-mode/.
schedule: CRON_TZ=Asia/Karachi every 5 min: team-gate.ps1 starts a new conversation ONLY if TEAM.lock is missing or older than 90 min (heartbeat after every step)
notes: Recommended Shahdara setup (sequential). Replaces the 3 parallel agents: never run it together with them or with shahdara-ui.
Gate log: shahdara-project\team-gate.log. To restart a stuck cycle at once: delete shahdara-project\TEAM.lock.

agent4 (shahdara-polish-qa) keeps agent4\FEATURE_AUDIT.md (Works/Broken/Ugly per button) and adds Playwright e2e tests (tests/e2e/*.spec.mjs) + a CI e2e job. Covered by the existing sidecar grants (command(npx), command(npm), command(node), write_file on shahdara-project); no sidecar change needed.
Turn order (solo): every turn is agent4; NEXT_AGENT.txt = '2 agent4'. After 3 agent4 turns the run deletes TEAM.lock and ends; the gate starts a fresh conversation within 5 min.

Switch back to team mode (6-slot rotation agent1 -> agent4 -> agent2 -> agent4 -> agent3 -> agent4): copy team-mode/TEAM.md, TEAM_PROMPT.txt, AGENTS.md, agent4/TASK.md over the PC files, set NEXT_AGENT.txt to '1 agent1', remove the PAUSED line at the top of agent1-3 STATE files. No sidecar change and no restart needed (next conversation reads the files).

grok-review: Grok files GitHub issues labeled grok-review every 2 h; agent4 lists them at the start of every turn (GitHub MCP list_issues/search_issues, already granted), fixes them first and closes them via 'Fixes #N'.
